data_identity.description: three-day deterministic price and feature sequence; no market result

future_horizon: no fixed time barrier; follow-up ends at the registered discovery-data boundary
outcome_warning: An eventual higher close alone does not establish a good entry; next-change direction, prior direction, waiting time and censoring must be read together. No high-rate acceptance gate.
confidence_or_significance: not measured; overlapping descriptive alerts are not independent binomial trials
